description: Source code implementing FIS table updating functions for MTD devices, including functions for opening, validating, and remapping FIS tables, with data structures for FIS image headers and CRCs.

methods.name: fis_close
methods.description: Closes the FIS mapping and file descriptor, unmapping memory and closing file handles.

methods.name: fis_open
methods.description: Opens and maps the FIS table from the device, returning a pointer to the descriptor.

methods.name: fis_validate
methods.description: Validates the FIS table against old and new partition info.

methods.name: fis_remap
methods.description: Remaps the FIS table with new partition information, updating memory and device accordingly.
